corrections.reason: The negative subordinate verb translating 'ኢትኔጽር' is 'ሳታይ' ('without seeing'); the initial 'ሳ' at the end of the line was misread as 'ታ'.
The negative verb translating 'ወናሁ ኢትሬኢ' is 'ሳታይ' ('while not seeing'); the printed 'ሳ' at the end of line 15 was misread as 'ያ'.
The printed Ge'ez interrogative is 'ምንት' (with 6th-order ሳድስ 'ት' from 'ለምንት ትኔጽር'), not 'ምንተ'.
Both occurrences on this line clearly print 'ፆር' (spiritual warfare/temptation), matching the rest of the paragraph; the first 'ፆር' was misread as 'ጦር'.
